Dream 2026-11-22 linked 8 vignettes from 7 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-24 · retells · "the connective tissue of the underlying context gets lost" (The core working problem: speed without the bigger context (2026-10-24))
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "We can trace our refined records back to their context by doing this, and it will allow us to cross check" (A chat opens a container: the narrative is the initial semantic layer (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-27 · touches · "Semantic integrity is going to be directly related to navigability." (Navigability is semantic integrity; memory is layered and temporal; the dream cycle builds long-term memory by testing against scenarios (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "And not loose them in branches." (Decisions are scattered and lost in branches; do we need a decisions server? (2026-10-28))
- 2026-10-29 · touches · "I want to see if I can help his knowledge gathering with srs" (Vignette 2026-10-29: helping knowledge gathering with SRS)
- 2026-11-05 · touches · "We don't want to destroy provenance." (2026-11-05: We don't want to destroy provenance)
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "The srs spec contains some rationale. But the conversation from early in the year was not available" (The PDF for meaning is the project's foundation: the vignettes are recent, and the early conversation was not available to the agents (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "Mukti-user, federated, fractal, long term memory is an important part of the future" (Vignette 2026-11-06: multi-user, federated, fractal, long-term memory is an important part of the future)
